comment: ED18 (EB7) — E-Commerce Design & Experience Program performance budgets. Source: Ecommerce-Design-Master-Plan-2026-10-16.md 'Measurable targets'. Lab runs use Lighthouse's default mobile emulation (Moto G Power-class, simulated 4G throttling). INP is a FIELD metric — Lighthouse lab cannot measure it directly, so the lab proxy asserted here is total-blocking-time <= 200ms; the 200ms INP target itself is verified from real-user data (CrUX / web-vitals) after deploy, not from this script.

checkout.note: Checkout renders its form from client-fetched state; seed a cart first (the script cannot do this) or measure the loaded form state manually in the browser and compare 'interactive'. Budget per plan: interactive <= 3s on simulated 4G.
